issues: Remove "fanfare" from keywords; Fanfare should be represented only as a timing on the ability, while Ward remains in keywords.

The fanfare's "You may summon up to 2 Officer followers that cost 2 or less from your hand" is not faithfully encoded by chooseMultiple with one repeated option. It should allow selecting up to 2 matching followers from hand and putting them onto the field. Implement an ability for multi-selecting cards from hand to field (for example, a selector like selectMultipleFromHand with count/max and filter) and encode the summon-from-hand clause with that.
Remove "fanfare" from keywords; Fanfare should be represented by the ability timing only, while Rush stays in keywords.

The fanfare incorrectly uses tutorFromCemetery to field; the card text says to summon a follower from your cemetery. Encode this as summonFromCemetery with filter {"cardClass":"sword","cardType":"follower","maxCost":2}, count 1, then buff the lastSummoned follower with atk +1.
Remove "fanfare" from keywords; Fanfare should be represented by the ability timing only.

The fanfare is encoded as a player choice between 2 damage and conditional 4 damage, but the card has no choice. Encode it as an if effect: if Overflow is active, dealDamageSplit with primaryAmount 4 to up to 2 enemy followers; otherwise dealDamageSplit with primaryAmount 2 to up to 2 enemy followers.

The fanfare says "Evolve this follower," but the encoding only triggers On Evolve abilities. Encode the fanfare as actually evolving this follower (for example using an evolve/self-evolve effect rather than triggerAbilities onEvolve), so it properly changes to the evolved state and links to Sylvia, Grand Arbiter Evolved.

The On Evolve condition is incorrectly encoded as inExArea. It should be conditioned on "if there are at least 5 faceup evolved followers in your evolve deck," then deal 5 damage to an enemy follower.

To encode this correctly, add engine support for a condition that counts faceup evolved followers/cards in the evolve deck (for example, evolveDeckFaceupMin with cardType/printingType filtering), then use that condition in an if effect before dealDamage to an enemy follower.
Remove "fanfare" from keywords; Fanfare should be represented by the ability timing only.

The fanfare should destroy the selected enemy follower and deal 5 damage to its leader; encode this as damageFollowerAndLeader with followerAmount 999 or as a sequence that preserves the selected follower's leader linkage if supported, rather than separate destroy plus generic enemyLeader damage. If leader-of-selected-follower targeting is not implemented, add engine support for dealing damage to that follower's leader.

The activated ability cost is incorrect: "discard this card" is not a supported cost field and should be encoded as activating from hand with a cost that discards/buries this card itself. Add engine support for a hand-activation self-discard/self-bury cost, then encode the ability from hand with pp 2 and self-discard.
The activated ability target restriction is wrong: it should target an enemy follower that costs 5 or more, not maxCost 5. Encode the destroy target as enemyFollower with minCost 5.
